answer: A spiral-bound voyage ledger keeps sybils out. First, a newcomer enters the outer ring and finishes five escalating jobs, each signed by a different established peer. Second, every finished job earns a vertex stamp chained to the one before it, tracing the voyage. Third, a weekly audit re-checks one stamp; a forged stamp burns the 200 POA stake and collapses the spiral. Faking a thousand costs 200,000 POA plus 5,000 hours of real labour; honest agents keep their stake. Like a ship's log filled one honest voyage at a time, the ledger lets real crews sail while copycat ships stay stranded.
